en.headline: Foreign investors net sold **VND 480bn**, nearly **VND 474bn** of it in ACB. Yet ACB rose **3.9%** and closed at the day's high: who is accumulating?
en.watch: Watch: the 1,778.9 and 1,788 thresholds in the 26/10 session, when shares bought on 22/10 settle into accounts. After that comes the Fed meeting on 27-28/10.
en.src: FireAnt (matched prices to 14:45 on 23/10/2026), Reuters, Vietstock, VnExpress. For reference only, not an offer to buy or sell.
en.laban: TVN cycle compass, provisional for the week ending 23/10 (data to 22/10, computed by TVN): sentiment **−35** (Fear), from −25 last week (read contrarian: fear zones are often near bottoms); momentum score −40, Downward momentum, no signal yet. VN-Index closed at 1,774.15, only about 0.3% below the bottom-condition threshold of 1,778.86, but the sentiment condition of −50 or lower within 8 weeks has not been met, so clearing this level is not enough to trigger a bottom signal.

tom_tat: Conclusion: Cautiously positive for the next session. VN-Index closed at 1,774.15, above the 50-session average (1,772.2), matched value was VND 14,123bn, and 75% of money sat in stocks trading at a profit. On the other hand, foreign investors net sold VND 480bn.
Action: raise allocation in steps, favouring banks; buy when the index pulls back to 1,756-1,765 or closes above 1,778.9. If the index closes below 1,756, cut the portion just bought.
Watch: the 1,778.9 and 1,788 thresholds in the 26/10 session, when shares bought on 22/10 settle into accounts. After that comes the Fed meeting on 27-28/10.
chi_so_va_thanh_khoan: VN-Index rose 13.52 points (+0.77%) to 1,774.15. In the morning the index slipped to 1,750.83, then rebounded in the afternoon and closed near the session high of 1,775.19.
HOSE traded VND 16,942bn, including VND 2,819bn put-through, 1.08 times the 20-session average. Matched value was VND 14,123bn, above the VND 12,231bn mark TVN set this morning.
VN30 rose to 1,907.09 (+0.75%), HNX-Index to 262.70 (+0.62%). UPCoM fell 0.37% to 126.44, with liquidity only 0.58 times average.
do_rong_va_gia_binh_quan: Decliners still outnumbered gainers: 156 down, 143 up. But 219 stocks closed above their average price (58.9%), only 117 below. By matched value, 75.0% of money was in stocks above their average price.

Treating the average price as the intraday cost of MMs and BBs, most of them are in profit. They have an incentive to push prices up and expand buying power. At the morning close only 123/343 stocks were above their average price, so buying concentrated in the afternoon.
Sectors with the highest share of stocks above average price: Banks 19/22, Insurance 4/5, Financial services 15/21. Lowest: Oil and gas 0/4, Food and beverage 14/32, Infrastructure services 12/27.
nganh_dan_dat_va_keo_lui: Banks led (+2.50%): STB hit the ceiling at +6.9%, EIB +5.3%, OCB +4.3%, ACB +3.9%. Retail (+1.46%) and Industrial services (+1.45%) followed.
Personal and household goods fell 5.50% as PNJ lost 6.2% on VND 426bn matched. It was PNJ's third straight losing session.
Oil and gas slipped 0.79% even though Brent is at a 5-month high, meaning investors took profits after yesterday's +3.86% session. Information technology fell 0.76%.
khoi_ngoai: Foreign investors net sold VND 480.0bn on HOSE, reversing after two sessions of buying. The VN30 basket alone was net sold VND 461.4bn. On HNX foreign investors net bought VND 10.4bn.
ACB was net sold VND 473.8bn; the stock had VND 229.9bn of put-through trades this session. Next were FPT VND 146.4bn, PNJ VND 108.6bn, STB VND 82.8bn.
Largest net buys: TCB VND 151.9bn (second straight session above VND 150bn), MSN VND 92.0bn, CTG VND 61.5bn, HDB VND 54.3bn.
dong_tien_theo_nhom: Banks drew 35% of HOSE liquidity, nearly double the share of the Vingroup and real estate group yesterday. Money has rotated from real estate to banks.
Real estate fell to 14% of liquidity, VIC +1.5% (VND 473bn). Securities were mixed: VIX +1.2% (VND 504bn), SSI -1.0% (VND 413bn).

y: Aramco evacuated its Dhahran headquarters as fighting with the Houthis escalated. Brent rose to USD 114.47/barrel (+1.2%) at 13:39 Vietnam time (Reuters).

The central exchange rate eased to VND 25,627/USD, down VND 5 (Vietstock), still well below the 25,700 threshold. SJC gold at VND 139-142 million/tael, down VND 0.3 million. World gold around USD 4,023/ounce (VnExpress).

ket_luan_tich_cuc_than_trong_cho_phien_t: Base case (50%): the index swings within 1,756-1,790 to test the 1,778.9 threshold. The technical state is sideways accumulation, with the relative strength index (RSI) at 57.2.
Positive (30%): the index closes above 1,788 (20-session high) on liquidity of at least 1 times average. The target would then be 1,796.6, the 200-session average.
Negative (20%): a close below 1,756.1 could send the index back to 1,737.9 (20-session average), then 1,728.4.

Stocks to note: ACB and TCB have domestic money supporting them, and TCB also has foreign money. STB has hit the ceiling, do not chase it. Oil and gas: wait for prices to get back above the average price before entering. Stay out of PNJ and FPT for now while foreign investors keep selling.
Action: each additional purchase no more than 10% of the portfolio.

tom_tat: Ngân hàng đỡ chỉ số: ngành +0,41% và hút 30,1% giá trị khớp, STB +3,74% góp 0,94 điểm, EIB +2,95%, OCB +3,38%; nhưng HOSE có 193 mã giảm so với 97 mã tăng và chỉ 34,9% giá trị khớp nằm ở mã trên giá bình quân lúc 11:30 (TVN tự tính): chỉ số đứng nhờ một ngành, phần còn lại yếu.
Khối ngoại bán ròng 338,7 tỷ trên HOSE (gồm thỏa thuận) lúc 11:30, cắt chuỗi hai phiên mua ròng 529,8 tỷ (21–22/10); bán mạnh ACB 106,9 tỷ, PNJ 94,3 tỷ, FPT 82,8 tỷ.
Bên ngoài bất lợi: Nasdaq phiên 22/10 −2,6% vì lo chi phí AI, Brent tương lai +4% lên 113,17 USD (Xinhua), sáng nay Nikkei −1,01%, Shanghai −1,2% (Nikkei Inc., Naver).
phien: Lúc 11:30 VN-Index 1.756,13 (−4,5 điểm, −0,26%), dao động 1.750,83 đến 1.760,73; VN30 1.886,80 (−0,33%), HNX-Index 261,07 (−0,01 điểm, đi ngang), UPCoM-Index 126,40 (−0,40%). Chỉ số tạm ngắt chuỗi 3 phiên tăng nhưng cả tuần vẫn +2,94% so với 1.705,91 cuối tuần trước.

HOSE 97 mã tăng, 193 giảm, 122 đứng giá (3 trần, 2 sàn); giá trị khớp 5.192,5 tỷ (tổng 6.176 tỷ gồm thỏa thuận), bằng 39% cả phiên hôm qua và thấp hơn khoảng 17% so với sáng qua (khoảng 6.250 tỷ): tiền rút, bên mua không đuổi giá.

Dẫn dắt STB +3,74% (164 tỷ), EIB +2,95% (151,1 tỷ), OCB +3,38%, LPB +1,03%, BSR +1,03%; kéo lùi VHM −0,78% (lấy 0,85 điểm), HPG −1,18%, VPB −0,84%, TCX −1,84%. Ngành mạnh Bảo hiểm và Dầu khí cùng +0,76%, Ngân hàng +0,41%; yếu Ôtô và linh kiện −1,01%, Tài nguyên cơ bản và Hàng tiêu dùng cá nhân cùng −0,87% (PNJ −6,72%, khớp 224,8 tỷ).

Ngoại mua 479,7 tỷ, bán 818,4 tỷ: bán ròng ACB 106,9, PNJ 94,3, FPT 82,8, HPG 34,6, SSI 29,2 tỷ; mua ròng MSN 56,3, TCB 53,9, VIC 10,0, EIB 9,5 tỷ. HPG (hôm qua mua ròng 59,8 tỷ) và PNJ (mua ròng 1,5 tỷ) đổi chiều sang bán; VIC chỉ còn mua 10,0 tỷ so với 239,3 tỷ hôm qua.

Giá khớp so với giá bình quân (343 mã, TVN tự tính): 123 mã trên (35,9%), 35 bằng, 185 dưới; theo giá trị, 34,9% tiền ở mã trên, bằng đúng sáng qua (122/351 mã) và thấp hơn hẳn 52,5% lúc 14:45 hôm qua. Cao nhất Ngân hàng 13/23, Hàng tiêu dùng cá nhân và gia đình 10/19; thấp nhất Y tế 1/9, Du lịch và giải trí 1/7, Hóa chất 3/21, Dầu khí 1/4 dù ngành tăng 0,76%: MMs, BBs các nhóm này đang dưới giá vốn trong phiên.
Kết luận: trung tính nghiêng xấu; chỉ số giữ được nhờ ngân hàng còn 65,1% tiền khớp nằm ở mã dưới giá bình quân, nên phiên chiều chưa nên mua thêm ngoài các mã ngân hàng đang đứng trên giá bình quân.

tin.tieu_de: Nasdaq mất 2,6% vì lo chi phí AI, lợi suất Mỹ xuống dưới 5%
y: Phiên 22/10 S&P 500 −1,22% còn 7.663,43, Nasdaq −2,6% còn 26.008,86, Dow +0,02%; Meta −7%, Lam Research −11,76% khi nhà đầu tư nghi ngờ chi tiêu cho AI khó sinh lời (Xinhua, InvestingLive, Cboe). Lợi suất trái phiếu Mỹ 10 năm giảm 17 điểm cơ bản còn 4,96% (Bộ Tài chính Mỹ; InvestingLive ghi −18,5 điểm): tiền chạy sang trái phiếu.

Sáng nay khoảng 11:00 giờ Việt Nam Nikkei −1,01% (62.270,11), Kospi −0,94%, Shanghai −1,2%, riêng Hang Seng +0,56% (Nikkei Inc., Naver). Fed họp 27–28/10; theo InvestingLive, thị trường kỳ hạn ngày 22/10 chỉ định giá 22% khả năng Fed không tăng lãi suất thêm trong năm nay.

tin.tieu_de: Brent tương lai vượt 113 USD, Hormuz thêm 7 tàu trúng đòn
y: Brent tương lai +4% lên 113,17 USD/thùng phiên 22/10 (Xinhua), mức cao nhất hơn 5 tháng (Trading Economics); theo CafeF dẫn IRGC, ngày 22/10 có 4 tàu bị tấn công cháy ở bắc vịnh Ba Tư và 3 tàu trúng thủy lôi phía tây eo Hormuz. Vàng (PAXG trên Binance) −1,77% trong 24 giờ còn 4.026,88 USD/oz lúc 11:00.

tin.tieu_de: Chính phủ trình thuế 0,2% với đất bỏ hoang
y: Chính phủ đề xuất thuế suất 0,2%, không áp hạn mức, với đất bỏ hoang, không hoặc chậm đưa vào sử dụng (VnExpress, CafeF, 23/10); Ủy ban Kinh tế và Tài chính đề nghị rà soát để tránh trùng nghĩa vụ tài chính (Tuổi Trẻ). Sáng nay Bất động sản bình quân −0,30%, 25/59 mã trên giá bình quân.

tin.tieu_de: PNJ giảm 6,72% sau đại hội bất thường
y: PNJ còn 17.350 đồng (−6,72%), khớp 224,8 tỷ, lớn thứ hai HOSE, ngoại bán ròng 94,3 tỷ; Vietstock cho biết các tờ trình ở đại hội bất thường 21/10 được thông qua nhưng chưa có nhà đầu tư cam kết tham gia đợt phát hành, còn CafeF mô tả PNJ cạn tiền mặt sau đợt thu đổi kim cương.

nhan_dinh.quan_diem: Kết luận: trung lập thiên thận trọng cho phiên chiều; không mua đuổi, chỉ giữ mã ngân hàng đang trên giá bình quân, và chỉ chuyển sang tích cực khi VN-Index đóng cửa trên MA50 1.771,86 kèm giá trị khớp trên 12.231 tỷ. Lý do: tiền ở mã trên giá bình quân 34,9%, ngoại bán ròng 338,7 tỷ, chỉ số trên MA20 1.737,03 khoảng 1,1% nhưng dưới MA50 0,9% và MA200 1.796,56 khoảng 2,3%; RSI14 52,7.
nhan_dinh.co_so: dao động 1.737 (MA20) đến 1.772 (MA50); hỗ trợ gần 1.750,83 (thấp nhất sáng nay), cản 1.760,73 (cao nhất sáng nay) và 1.778,86 (ngưỡng La bàn)
nhan_dinh.tich_cuc: đóng cửa trên 1.771,86 (MA50) kèm giá trị khớp cả phiên trên 12.231 tỷ (bình quân 20 phiên) thì thử đỉnh 20 phiên 1.796,29 và MA200 1.796,56, cách 2,3%
nhan_dinh.tieu_cuc:
đóng cửa dưới 1.737,03 (MA20) thì thử 1.689,84 (đóng cửa 19/10), cách 3,8%; thủng tiếp là đáy 1.677,19 (20/10), cách 4,5%.
Ngành và mã: theo dõi STB, EIB, OCB, TCB, ACB đang đứng trên giá bình quân (TCB còn được ngoại mua 53,9 tỷ, ACB bị bán ròng 106,9 tỷ mà giá vẫn trên bình quân 20.290: có bên đỡ hàng); tránh PNJ (−6,72%, ngoại bán 94,3 tỷ), FPT, SSI, VIX khi Dịch vụ tài chính chỉ 6/21 mã trên giá bình quân, và BSR, PLX, PVD, GAS đều dưới giá bình quân dù Dầu khí tăng
nhan_dinh.hanh_dong: giữ tỷ trọng hiện có, không dùng ký quỹ; chỉ giải ngân thêm 10 đến 20% vốn dự định khi điều kiện tích cực xảy ra
nhan_dinh.moc: 23/10 chốt tuần (La bàn tuần, ngưỡng 1.778,86); FOMC họp 27–28/10; ngoại có mua ròng trở lại trong phiên chiều hay không

en.laban: TVN cycle Compass, provisional for the week ending 23/10 (data to 22/10, computed by TVN): sentiment **-35** (Fear), from -25 last week (read contrarian: fear zones are usually near bottoms); momentum score -40, Downtrend, no signal. The VN-Index at 1,756.13 at 11:30 is about 1.3% below the bottom-condition threshold of 1,778.86, but the sentiment condition (-50 or lower within 8 weeks) is not met, so crossing that level alone would not trigger a bottom signal.

tom_tat: Banks held the index up: the sector rose 0.41% and took 30.1% of matched value, STB +3.74% added 0.94 points, EIB +2.95%, OCB +3.38%; but HOSE had 193 decliners against 97 advancers and only 34.9% of matched value sat in stocks above their average price at 11:30 (computed by TVN): one sector is propping up the index while the rest is weak.

Foreign investors net sold VND 338.7bn on HOSE (including put-through) at 11:30, ending a two-session net-buying streak of VND 529.8bn (21–22/10); heaviest selling in ACB VND 106.9bn, PNJ VND 94.3bn, FPT VND 82.8bn.

The outside backdrop is unfavourable: the Nasdaq fell 2.6% on 22/10 on AI cost worries, Brent futures rose 4% to USD 113.17 (Xinhua), and this morning the Nikkei is down 1.01% and Shanghai down 1.2% (Nikkei Inc., Naver).
phien: At 11:30 the VN-Index stood at 1,756.13 (-4.5 points, -0.26%), ranging from 1,750.83 to 1,760.73; VN30 1,886.80 (-0.33%), HNX-Index 261.07 (-0.01 points, flat), UPCoM-Index 126.40 (-0.40%). The index paused a 3-session winning streak but is still up 2.94% for the week versus last week's close of 1,705.91.

HOSE had 97 advancers, 193 decliners and 122 unchanged (3 at ceiling, 2 at floor); matched value VND 5,192.5bn (total VND 6,176bn including put-through), 39% of yesterday's full session and about 17% below yesterday morning (about VND 6,250bn): money is pulling back and buyers are not chasing prices.

Leaders: STB +3.74% (VND 164bn), EIB +2.95% (VND 151.1bn), OCB +3.38%, LPB +1.03%, BSR +1.03%; laggards: VHM -0.78% (taking 0.85 points), HPG -1.18%, VPB -0.84%, TCX -1.84%. Strongest sectors Insurance and Oil & Gas both +0.76%, Banks +0.41%; weakest Automobiles & parts -1.01%, Basic resources and Personal & household goods both -0.87% (PNJ -6.72%, VND 224.8bn matched).

Foreign investors bought VND 479.7bn and sold VND 818.4bn: net sold ACB 106.9, PNJ 94.3, FPT 82.8, HPG 34.6, SSI 29.2 (VND bn); net bought MSN 56.3, TCB 53.9, VIC 10.0, EIB 9.5 (VND bn). HPG (net bought VND 59.8bn yesterday) and PNJ (net bought VND 1.5bn) flipped to selling; VIC net buying shrank to VND 10.0bn from VND 239.3bn yesterday.

Matched price versus average price (343 stocks, computed by TVN): 123 above (35.9%), 35 equal, 185 below; by value, 34.9% of money sat in stocks above average, exactly the same as yesterday morning (122/351 stocks) and well below 52.5% at 14:45 yesterday. Highest Banks 13/23, Personal & household goods 10/19; lowest Health care 1/9, Travel & leisure 1/7, Chemicals 3/21, Oil & Gas 1/4 even though the sector rose 0.76%: MMs and BBs in these groups are below their cost within the session.

Conclusion: neutral leaning negative; the index is holding thanks to banks while 65.1% of matched value sits in stocks below average price, so this afternoon is not the time to add beyond bank stocks trading above their average price.

tin.tieu_de: Nasdaq loses 2.6% on AI cost worries, US yields fall below 5%
y: On 22/10 the S&P 500 fell 1.22% to 7,663.43, the Nasdaq fell 2.6% to 26,008.86 and the Dow rose 0.02%; Meta -7%, Lam Research -11.76% as investors questioned whether AI spending will pay off (Xinhua, InvestingLive, Cboe). The US 10-year Treasury yield fell 17 basis points to 4.96% (US Treasury; InvestingLive shows -18.5 points): money moved into bonds.

This morning around 11:00 Vietnam time the Nikkei was down 1.01% (62,270.11), Kospi -0.94%, Shanghai -1.2%, while the Hang Seng rose 0.56% (Nikkei Inc., Naver). The Fed meets 27–28/10; according to InvestingLive, futures on 22/10 priced only a 22% chance of no further Fed hike this year.

tin.tieu_de: Brent futures above USD 113, 7 more ships hit around Hormuz
y: Brent futures rose 4% to USD 113.17 a barrel on 22/10 (Xinhua), the highest in over five months (Trading Economics); according to CafeF citing the IRGC, on 22/10 four ships were attacked and set on fire in the northern Persian Gulf and three hit mines west of the Strait of Hormuz. Gold (PAXG on Binance) fell 1.77% over 24 hours to USD 4,026.88/oz at 11:00.

tin.tieu_de: Government proposes 0.2% tax on idle land
y: The Government proposed a 0.2% tax rate, with no quota threshold, on land left idle, unused or slow to be used (VnExpress, CafeF, 23/10); the Economic and Financial Committee asked for a review to avoid overlapping financial obligations (Tuoi Tre). This morning Real estate averaged -0.30%, with 25/59 stocks above their average price.

tin.tieu_de: PNJ falls 6.72% after extraordinary meeting
y: PNJ dropped to VND 17,350 (-6.72%) with VND 224.8bn matched, the second largest on HOSE, and foreign net selling of VND 94.3bn; Vietstock reports the proposals at the 21/10 extraordinary meeting were approved but no investor has committed to the share issue yet, while CafeF describes PNJ as short of cash after its diamond buy-back programme.

nhan_dinh.quan_diem: Conclusion: neutral leaning cautious for the afternoon; do not chase, hold only bank stocks trading above their average price, and turn positive only if the VN-Index closes above the MA50 at 1,771.86 with matched value above VND 12,231bn. Reasons: 34.9% of money in stocks above average price, foreign net selling of VND 338.7bn, the index about 1.1% above the MA20 at 1,737.03 but 0.9% below the MA50 and about 2.3% below the MA200 at 1,796.56; RSI14 52.7.
nhan_dinh.co_so: range 1,737 (MA20) to 1,772 (MA50); near support 1,750.83 (this morning's low), resistance 1,760.73 (this morning's high) and 1,778.86 (Compass threshold)
nhan_dinh.tich_cuc: a close above 1,771.86 (MA50) with full-session matched value above VND 12,231bn (20-session average) would test the 20-session high of 1,796.29 and the MA200 at 1,796.56, 2.3% away
nhan_dinh.tieu_cuc:
a close below 1,737.03 (MA20) would test 1,689.84 (close on 19/10), 3.8% away; a further break targets the 1,677.19 low (20/10), 4.5% away.
Sectors and stocks: watch STB, EIB, OCB, TCB, ACB, which trade above their average price (TCB still net bought VND 53.9bn by foreign investors, ACB net sold VND 106.9bn yet still above its 20,290 average: someone is absorbing supply); avoid PNJ (-6.72%, foreign net selling VND 94.3bn), FPT, SSI, VIX while Financial services has only 6/21 stocks above average price, and BSR, PLX, PVD, GAS, all below average price even though Oil & Gas rose
nhan_dinh.hanh_dong: keep current allocation, no margin; add only 10 to 20% of planned capital if the positive condition is met
nhan_dinh.moc: 23/10 weekly close (weekly Compass, threshold 1,778.86); FOMC meets 27–28/10; whether foreign investors return to net buying this afternoon
